title: Easy words may hold another experience

captions.physics: Voicing impressions through an indirect remark
captions.energy: Developing conversation through attention to experience

meaning: You can voice an impression through an indirect remark and develop conversation through attention to actual experience, feeling an unfamiliar perspective without immediately having to abandon your own.
text: The Moon in the physical position of your Vishuddha can appear in an indirect remark conveying an impression instead of a question. The Empress in energy supports a wish to develop conversation through attention to actual experience and details. The Hanged Man in emotions brings an unfamiliar different perspective. You can hear something previously unnoticed behind a fluent account without immediately knowing how to answer now.

For example, a coherent explanation receives “It all seems so easy for you”, although admiration and your own confusion are both present in those words. You can ask how suitable words were actually found. **Attention to details changes the visible impression**. It emerges that the answer was considered for a long time. The earlier perspective is suspended: easy delivery did not mean the whole experience was easy. Awkwardness about this difference can coexist with a right to describe your own difficulty without comparing its value to what was heard.

Difficulty arises if another view means an obligation to forget your own response: since the other person also struggled, your confusion supposedly has no room. Conversation loses one living side. Constructive Empress energy helps develop substance, including different details of experience. You can acknowledge an inaccurate first impression and still need explanation; an unfamiliar perspective requires neither immediate agreement about everything nor competition over whose difficulty was real and worthy of attention.
